# Child Mind Institute

> A leading nonprofit organization dedicated to transforming the lives of children with mental health and learning disorders through clinical care, research, and family support.

Child Mind Institute is a national nonprofit with locations in New York City and the San Francisco Bay Area. The organization combines clinical expertise with groundbreaking neuroscience research to provide comprehensive mental health and learning disorder services for children and families.

## Key Topics

- Children's Mental Health
- Learning Disorders
- Autism
- ADHD
- Anxiety
- Depression
- Clinical Care
- Neuroscience Research
- Family Support
- Education Programs
- Healthy Brain Network
- Brain Imaging
- Child Development
- Behavioral Health
- Evidence-Based Treatment

## About Child Mind Institute

- [Child Mind Institute | Transforming Children's Lives](https://childmind.org): Nonprofit organization transforming lives of children with mental health and learning disorders through clinical care, research, and family support
